Reech Solar Enterprises is a Southern California-based solar, roofing, battery storage, maintenance, and energy consulting company with more than 15 years of industry experience.

Reech supports homeowners through the full solar ownership lifecycle, from installation and expansion to diagnostics, repairs, roofing, battery backup, monitoring, and property sale inspections.

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear guidance for your solar journey

Reech provides solar installation, solar expansions, battery backup, roofing, solar removal and reinstallation, diagnostics, repairs, panel cleaning, maintenance plans, ADU solar support, ground-mounted solar, solar patios and carports, and real estate solar reports.

Reech reviews your utility usage, roof condition, shade, energy goals, budget, and long-term savings potential. If solar is not the right fit, Reech provides honest guidance instead of forcing a sale.

Yes. Reech supports orphaned solar systems through monitoring setup, diagnostics, repairs, warranty review, maintenance plans, and long-term system support.

Yes. Reech can evaluate your existing system and design supplemental solar if your energy usage has increased due to EVs, ADUs, pools, home additions, larger family size, or battery charging needs.

Yes. Reech provides roofing services, roof repairs, roof replacement, solar removal, reinstallation, testing, and performance verification to support solar and roofing projects together.

Solar systems are generally low-maintenance, but monitoring, inspections, cleaning, and diagnostics help protect performance and detect issues early.
